reference: Policy wording, sections 5, 8 and 10; claims manual, unattended belongings

reason: The policy was bought on June 20, so the 60 days before it start on April 21. The one visit for back strain was on April 10, before the window, with no treatment, visits or medication change since, so the condition is not pre-existing. The five treatment lines abroad come to $2,696.50. The physiotherapy at home is follow-up care and is not covered. The $50 deductible comes off, leaving $2,646.50. The payout needs sign-off.
reference: Policy wording, section 7; claims manual, pre-existing conditions and treatment that can wait
tests: An earlier visit for back trouble that falls just outside the 60-day window, and follow-up care at home to leave out

reason: The carrier confirms a delay of 13 hours caused by a strike, past the 6 hour waiting period on Premium. The hotel, the meals and the taxis are covered and come to $279.70, inside the $800 maximum with no deductible. The paid night in Bologna is a consequential loss under section 9 and is left out.
tests: A covered strike delay with a consequential loss to leave out

reason: Section 2 pays for a cancellation only for the reasons it lists, and a visa that did not arrive in time is not one of them. The claim is declined under section 2.
tests: A well-documented non-refundable loss, but the visa delay is not a covered reason to cancel
